scripts.tg:set-webhook: bash --noprofile --norc -c 'set -euo pipefail; u="${TG_WEBHOOK_URL:?TG_WEBHOOK_URL is required}"; t="${TG_TOKEN:?TG_TOKEN is required}"; if [[ "$u" != http://* && "$u" != https://* ]]; then echo "TG_WEBHOOK_URL must start with http:// or https://" >&2; exit 1; fi; if [[ "$u" == http://* ]]; then rest="${u#http://}"; scheme="http"; else rest="${u#https://}"; scheme="https"; fi; hostport="${rest%%/*}"; path="${rest#*/}"; if [[ "$path" == "$rest" ]]; then path=""; fi; path="${path#/}"; export HOST="${scheme}://${hostport}"; if [[ -z "$path" ]]; then export ENDPOINT="api/telegram"; else export ENDPOINT="$path"; fi; export TOKEN="$t"; node tools/change-telegram-bot-host.js'
scripts.tg:webhook-info: bash --noprofile --norc -c 'set -euo pipefail; : "${TG_TOKEN:?TG_TOKEN is required}"; curl -sS "https://api.telegram.org/bot${TG_TOKEN}/getWebhookInfo"; echo'
